parts.zh: 美国联合航空公司为误将一个美国家庭的宠物狗运送到数千英里外的日本方向而道歉
狗主人心爱的10岁狗狗名叫Buddy
狗主人一家目前正在搬家过程中
但当他们到达美国南部州的美国联合航空公司货运设施时
这两只狗都在丹佛转机时被送到了错误的目的地
Buddy抵达东京国际机场后接受了身体检查
"我太高兴了,它还活着并且很快就要回家了!"如释重负的狗主人说
"在丹佛转机期间发生了一个错误。我们已通知客户他们的宠物安全抵达。我们将尽快安排将宠物送还给他们。"美国联合航空公司发言人表示
W: 其实,鸭子从来都不受像我祖父这样的农民欢迎

items.stem: What does the news report say about United Airlines?

choices.text: It found a pet dog on board a plane to a city in Texas.
choices.zh: 在一架飞往德克萨斯州某城市的飞机上发现了一只宠物狗。

choices.text: It had one of its cargo planes land at a wrong airport.
choices.zh: 其中一架货运飞机降落在了错误的机场。

choices.text: It sent two dogs to the wrong destinations.
choices.zh: 将两只狗送到了错误的目的地。

choices.text: It had two of its domestic flights mixed up.
choices.zh: 将其两个国内航班搞混了。

items.stem: What did the spokesperson for United Airlines say they would do after the incident?

choices.text: Correct their mistake as soon as possible.
choices.zh: 尽快纠正他们的错误。

choices.text: Give the two pets a physical checkup.
choices.zh: 给这两只宠物做身体检查。

choices.text: Hire a charter jet to bring the pets back.
choices.zh: 租用包机把宠物送回来。

choices.text: Send another plane to continue the flight.
choices.zh: 派另一架飞机继续该航班。

items.stem: What do we learn about the mother elephant Semba?

choices.text: She weighs 130 kilograms.
choices.zh: 她体重130公斤。

choices.text: She has had babies before.
choices.zh: 她以前生过小象。

choices.text: She was brought from Africa.
choices.zh: 她是从非洲带来的。

choices.text: She has a big family of six.
choices.zh: 她有一个六口之家的大家庭。

items.stem: What does the report say about the birth of the new baby elephant?

choices.text: It took 22 hours.
choices.zh: 花了22小时。

choices.text: It had some complications.
choices.zh: 有一些并发症。

choices.text: It was smooth.
choices.zh: 很顺利。

choices.text: It was monitored by Dr. Sue Tygielski.
choices.zh: 由Sue Tygielski博士监护。

items.stem: What do we learn about the restaurant?

choices.text: It enjoyed great popularity.
choices.zh: 它非常受欢迎。

choices.text: It started business three years ago.
choices.zh: 它三年前开始营业。

choices.text: It was frequented by newly-weds.
choices.zh: 它经常有新婚夫妇光顾。

choices.text: It was built above the sea-water.
choices.zh: 它建在海面上。

items.stem: What did the restaurant manager decide to do recently?

choices.text: Expand his business on the beach.
choices.zh: 在海滩上扩展他的生意。

choices.text: Replace the restaurant's wooden deck.
choices.zh: 更换餐厅的木质平台。

choices.text: Post a picture of his restaurant online.
choices.zh: 在网上发布他餐厅的照片。

choices.text: Celebrate his silver wedding anniversary.
choices.zh: 庆祝他的银婚纪念日。

items.stem: What did the waitress do about the recovered ring?

choices.text: She sold it for two thousand dollars.
choices.zh: 她以两千美元的价格把它卖了。

choices.text: She took it to the restaurant manager.
choices.zh: 她把它交给了餐厅经理。

choices.text: She posted its picture on Facebook.
choices.zh: 她在Facebook上发布了它的照片。

choices.text: She returned it to its owner right away.
choices.zh: 她立即把它归还给了失主。

items.stem: What does the woman find unbelievable?

choices.text: The number of ducks has declined sharply in recent years.
choices.zh: 近年来鸭子的数量急剧下降。

choices.text: Climate change has little effect on the lives of wild ducks.
choices.zh: 气候变化对野鸭的生活影响甚微。

choices.text: Duck meat is not eaten in Australia, Canada and the U.S.
choices.zh: 在澳大利亚、加拿大和美国不吃鸭肉。

choices.text: Duck hunting remains legal in many parts of the world.
choices.zh: 在世界许多地方捕猎鸭子仍然是合法的。

items.stem: What does the woman say has caused the shrinking of ducks' habitats in Australia?

choices.text: Droughts.
choices.zh: 干旱。

choices.text: Bushfires.
choices.zh: 丛林火灾。

choices.text: Farming.
choices.zh: 农业耕作。

choices.text: Hunting.
choices.zh: 捕猎。

items.stem: Why is there no commercial farming of ducks and geese in Western countries?

choices.text: They are not easy to domesticate.
choices.zh: 它们不容易驯化。

choices.text: Their meat is not that popular.
choices.zh: 它们的肉不那么受欢迎。

choices.text: It is not environmentally friendly.
choices.zh: 这不环保。

choices.text: It is not considered cost-effective.
choices.zh: 这被认为不具成本效益。

items.stem: What does the woman say about farmers in her grandfather's time?

choices.text: They hunted ducks as a traditional sport.
choices.zh: 他们把捕猎鸭子作为一项传统运动。

choices.text: They killed wild ducks and geese for food.
choices.zh: 他们猎杀野鸭和野鹅作为食物。

choices.text: They raised ducks and geese for their eggs.
choices.zh: 他们饲养鸭子和鹅以获取蛋。

choices.text: They poisoned wild ducks in large numbers.
choices.zh: 他们大量毒杀野鸭。

items.stem: What is the woman planning to do?

choices.text: Have her house repainted.
choices.zh: 让人重新粉刷她的房子。

choices.text: Replace some of her old furniture.
choices.zh: 更换她的一些旧家具。

choices.text: Move into a newly-painted house.
choices.zh: 搬进一所新粉刷的房子。

choices.text: Calculate the cost of the paint job.
choices.zh: 计算粉刷工作的费用。

items.stem: What is the woman's chief concern?

choices.text: How long the work will take.
choices.zh: 这项工作需要多长时间。

choices.text: How much the work will cost.
choices.zh: 这项工作需要花费多少钱。

choices.text: How the paint job is to be done.
choices.zh: 粉刷工作将如何进行。

choices.text: How many workers are needed.
choices.zh: 需要多少工人。

items.stem: What does the woman have to do while the paint job is being done?

choices.text: Cover up her furniture.
choices.zh: 把她的家具盖起来。

choices.text: Ask some friends for help.
choices.zh: 请一些朋友帮忙。

choices.text: Stay somewhere else.
choices.zh: 待在别的地方。

choices.text: Oversee the work herself.
choices.zh: 亲自监督工作。

items.stem: What has the woman come to realize at the end of the conversation?

choices.text: She could have asked a friend for help with the paint job.
choices.zh: 她本可以请朋友帮忙做粉刷工作。

choices.text: Painting a house involves more trouble than she thought.
choices.zh: 粉刷房子涉及的麻烦比她想象的多。

choices.text: She should have repainted her house much earlier.
choices.zh: 她应该早得多就重新粉刷她的房子。

choices.text: Moving her furniture is harder than the paint job.
choices.zh: 搬动她的家具比粉刷工作更困难。

items.stem: What is the main aim of homework for primary school kids?

choices.text: To cultivate good habits.
choices.zh: 培养良好的习惯。

choices.text: To prepare for secondary school.
choices.zh: 为中学做准备。

choices.text: To review what is learned in class.
choices.zh: 复习课堂上学到的内容。

choices.text: To stimulate interest in learning.
choices.zh: 激发学习兴趣。

items.stem: What does the passage suggest parents do to help their children?

choices.text: Discuss their academic achievements with them.
choices.zh: 与孩子讨论他们的学业成绩。

choices.text: Create an ideal study environment for them.
choices.zh: 为孩子创造理想的学习环境。

choices.text: Allow them to learn independently.
choices.zh: 允许孩子独立学习。

choices.text: Check their homework promptly.
choices.zh: 及时检查孩子的家庭作业。

items.stem: What should children do to deal with multiple assignments?

choices.text: Finish them before they get tired.
choices.zh: 在感到疲劳之前完成作业。

choices.text: Tackle the most difficult task first.
choices.zh: 先处理最困难的任务。

choices.text: Start with something they enjoy.
choices.zh: 从自己喜欢的内容开始。

choices.text: Focus on the most important ones.
choices.zh: 专注于最重要的作业。

items.stem: Who will qualify for the bonus in Mexican oil company?

choices.text: Workers who meet its body weight standards.
choices.zh: 符合其体重标准的员工。

choices.text: Workers who can lose 30 pounds in a year.
choices.zh: 一年内能减掉30磅的员工。

choices.text: Workers who try the hardest to lose weight.
choices.zh: 最努力减肥的员工。

choices.text: Workers who are in the top 10% of the slimmest.
choices.zh: 体重最轻的前10%的员工。

items.stem: What do critics think of Mexican oil company's bonus policy?

choices.text: Impractical.
choices.zh: 不切实际。

choices.text: Inconsistent.
choices.zh: 前后矛盾。

choices.text: Unmanageable.
choices.zh: 难以管理。

choices.text: Unfair.
choices.zh: 不公平。

items.stem: What do experts propose companies do about workers' wellbeing?

choices.text: Offer them much fatter bonuses.
choices.zh: 向他们提供更丰厚的奖金。

choices.text: Improve working environment.
choices.zh: 改善工作环境。

choices.text: Encourage healthy behaviors.
choices.zh: 鼓励健康行为。

choices.text: Provide free lunch and snacks.
choices.zh: 提供免费午餐和零食。

items.stem: Why are some people criticizing the British government?

choices.text: It has not done enough to help left-handed children.
choices.zh: 英国政府在帮助左撇子儿童方面做得不够。

choices.text: It has treated left-handed children as being disabled.
choices.zh: 英国政府把左撇子儿童当作残疾人对待。

choices.text: It has not built facilities specially for the left-handed.
choices.zh: 英国政府没有专门为左撇子建造设施。

choices.text: It has ignored campaigns on behalf of the left-handed.
choices.zh: 英国政府忽视了代表左撇子的运动。

items.stem: What do studies in recent years show about left-handed children?

choices.text: They are as intelligent as other children.
choices.zh: 他们和其他儿童一样聪明。

choices.text: They have a distinctive style of handwriting.
choices.zh: 他们有独特的书写风格。

choices.text: They sometimes have psychological problems.
choices.zh: 他们有时会有心理问题。

choices.text: They tend to have more difficulties in learning.
choices.zh: 他们在学习方面往往有更多困难。

items.stem: What do the campaigners demand the department of education do?

choices.text: Punish teachers discriminating against left-handed students.
choices.zh: 惩罚歧视左撇子学生的教师。

choices.text: Lay more emphasis on improving children's mental health.
choices.zh: 更加重视改善儿童的心理健康。

choices.text: Encourage students to develop various professional skills.
choices.zh: 鼓励学生发展各种专业技能。

choices.text: Keep track of left-handed children's school performance.
choices.zh: 跟踪左撇子儿童的学业表现。

items.stem: What do the campaigners want to know about left-handed prisoners?

choices.text: How they can be reduced in number.
choices.zh: 如何减少他们的数量。

choices.text: Why their numbers are so high.
choices.zh: 为什么他们的数量如此之高。

choices.text: What percentage they account for.
choices.zh: 他们占的百分比是多少。

choices.text: If their percentage keeps increasing.
choices.zh: 他们的百分比是否持续增加。
